title: Email clients about overdue invoices every day
body:
## Change
A daily job emails clients whose invoice is 3, 7 or 14 days overdue.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Reminders go out on days 3, 7 and 14 only
- [ ] Paid invoices get none

## Notes
Task 1. Plan the task before building. Epic: docs/plans/v1/03-reminders.md

title: Show reminder history on the invoice page
body:
## Value
Studios see which reminders a client already got.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each sent reminder is listed with its date
- [ ] An invoice with none says so
- [ ] The list updates after the daily job

## Notes
Task 2, depends on #53. Blocked by #53

title: Keep invoice totals from rounding a cent off
body:
## What happens
An invoice line of 2 x 4.35 shows a total of 8.69.

## Expected
8.70.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 2 x 4.35 totals 8.70
- [ ] Totals stay exact to the cent for any line prices with two decimals
